rot.ideia.ex1.e1: The pawn is on e2. The kings only complete the position and do not move.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: The pawn moves straight ahead, one square at a time, and never goes back.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: But on each pawn's first move, it may go two squares at once.
rot.ideia.ex1.p: Advance the pawn as far as you can in one move, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! Two squares, using the first move.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: On its first move, the pawn goes from e2 to e4, two squares.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.e2e3.1: One square is a valid move, but here it could go two.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.e2e3.2: Let's go back and use the first move.
rot.ideia.ex1.volta: Advance the pawn as far as you can in one move, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: After the first move, it is one square at a time.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: And there is no way back: the pawn never moves backwards or sideways.
rot.ideia.ex1.l3: Remember the idea: the pawn moves straight ahead; two squares only on its first move.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: A black knight is on e5, right in front of the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: The pawn only moves forward onto an empty square: it does not capture what is in front of it.
rot.ideia.ex2.e3: It captures diagonally, one square ahead: d5 or f5. The captured piece leaves the board.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Capture one of the black pieces on the diagonal, either one, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! The pawn captures diagonally and stands on d5.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The pawn captures the black pawn on d5, diagonally.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.e4f5.1: That works too! The pawn captures diagonally and stands on f5.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Capture one of the black pieces on the diagonal, either one, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: Both captures were fine: d5 and f5 are one square ahead, diagonally.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: The knight on e5, right in front, is the one piece the pawn cannot capture.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: With no black piece on the diagonal, the pawn does not go there.
rot.ideia.ex2.l4: Remember the idea: the pawn moves straight, but captures diagonally.
rot.ideia.ex3.e1: Finally, the most important rule: the pawn on e7 is one step from the last rank.
rot.ideia.ex3.e2: When it gets there, it turns into another piece: queen, rook, bishop or knight. This is called promotion.
rot.ideia.ex3.e3: Almost always the choice is the queen, the strongest piece; the others are for rare cases.
rot.ideia.ex3.p: Promote the pawn and choose the queen, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex3.revela: The pawn advances to e8 and becomes a queen.
rot.ideia.ex3.err.e7e8r.1: Promoting to a rook is allowed, but here the queen is stronger.
rot.ideia.ex3.err.e7e8r.2: Let's go back and choose the queen.
rot.ideia.ex3.err.e7e8b.1: Promoting to a bishop is allowed, but here the queen is stronger.
rot.ideia.ex3.err.e7e8b.2: Let's go back and choose the queen.
rot.ideia.ex3.err.e7e8n.1: Promoting to a knight is allowed, but here the queen is stronger.
rot.ideia.ex3.err.e7e8n.2: Let's go back and choose the queen.
rot.ideia.ex3.volta: Promote the pawn and choose the queen, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex3.l1: The smallest soldier became the strongest piece. That is why every advancing pawn deserves attention.
rot.ideia.ex3.l2: Remember the idea: a pawn that reaches the last rank becomes another piece, almost always a queen.
rot.ideia.ex3.l3: You have now seen the pawn's three rules. Now I will show them in other positions.
rot.demos.travado.e1: Here the two pawns face each other, on e4 and e5.
rot.demos.travado.e2: Neither can move: the square ahead is taken, and there is nothing to capture diagonally.
rot.demos.travado.l1: A blocked pawn stays put while the square ahead is taken and there is no black piece on its diagonal.
rot.demos.caminhada.e1: Watch a pawn's whole walk, from e2 to promotion.
rot.demos.caminhada.l1: Two squares on the first move...
rot.demos.caminhada.l3: ...two more moves, through e6 up to e7...
rot.demos.caminhada.l4: ...and, on e8, it becomes a queen.
rot.demos.caminhada.l5: Five moves in all, and the pawn became the strongest piece.
rot.demos.abrindo.e1: The pawn on e4 is blocked by the black pawn on e5.
rot.demos.abrindo.e2: But there is a black knight on d5, on its diagonal.
rot.demos.abrindo.l1: The pawn captures the knight and changes file.
rot.demos.abrindo.l2: On the d-file the way ahead is clear, and it goes on to d6.
rot.demos.abrindo.l3: A capture can free the pawn and open the road to promotion.
rot.demos.abrindo.l4: Now it's your turn: in the next positions, find the pawn's moves.
rot.pratica.capturaPromove.enunciado: The rook on b8 blocks the pawn. Promote anyway, in a single move.
rot.pratica.capturaPromove.fim: Perfect. Capturing and promoting can happen in the same move: the pawn captured and became a queen.
rot.pratica.capturaPromove.err.b7a8r: A rook is allowed, but the queen is stronger. Try again.
rot.pratica.caminhoAberto.enunciado: The knight on e6 blocks the pawn. In three moves, take the pawn to the last rank and promote to a queen.
rot.pratica.caminhoAberto.fim: Well done. You now know how to move the pawn: straight ahead, capturing diagonally and promoting on the last rank.
